info.name: restful_booker_API_Testing_V3_Simple
info.description:
# Restful-Booker API Testing - V3 (Simple)

Target: https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com (public practice API)

## How to run
1. Import the collection. Select an environment only if you want to override Base_URL.
2. Run the whole collection in the Collection Runner, in order (folder 12 last, it deletes the test data).
3. Any single folder can also be run alone: every folder creates its own booking and the collection logs in automatically.

## Collection variables
| Variable | What it is for |
|---|---|
| Base_URL | API address (an environment variable with the same name overrides it) |
| rb_admin_user / rb_admin_pass | Login of the public demo API |
| rb_run_known_defects | true = defect / validation / exploratory checks run (and fail when the bug is there). false = they are SKIPPED (for a green run). An environment variable with the same name overrides this value |
| rb_max_response_ms | Response time limit in ms (default 5000) |
| rb_token, rb_booking_id, rb_cleanup_ids | Filled in automatically while the collection runs |

## Folders
01 Health | 02 Authentication | 03 CRUD core | 04 Filtering | 05 Update/Patch | 06 Boundary | 07 Negative/Auth | 08 Robustness | 09 Delete/State | 10 Defects | 11 Exploratory | 12 Cleanup

## Notes
- Test names look like `PREFIX_NNN - description` (LIST, AUTH, POST, READ, FILTER, PUT, PATCH, PERSIST, ...).
- If a PUT or PATCH fails, the GET Verify request after it will also fail. Look at the FIRST failure.
- Filter tests for checkin / checkout assume: checkin = "on or after the date", checkout = "on or before the date". Check this in the API docs.
- If the server answers 403, the saved token is cleared and the next request logs in again.
- Newman: `newman run restful_booker_API_Testing_Final_Simple.postman_collection.json --env-var "rb_run_known_defects=false"` for a run without the known-defect checks.

item.name: 10_Defect Discovery
item.description: Confirmed validation defects. Each test asserts the CORRECT behaviour, so a failure = defect reproduced. Set collection variable rb_run_known_defects=false to mark them as skipped for a green regression/CI run.

item.name: DEFECT-001 Missing required firstname should return 4xx

request.description:
## DEFECT-001 - Missing required firstname should return 4xx

**Severity:** High | **Priority:** High

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Send `POST {{Base_URL}}/booking` with header `Content-Type: application/json`, `Accept: application/json`
2. Use the request body of this request

**Expected:** HTTP 400/422 with a validation message.

**Actual (observed in run):** HTTP 500 Internal Server Error (unhandled exception instead of validation).

Root cause class: missing-field validation. Same behaviour is checked for other fields in folder 08.

pm.test("DEFECT-001_001 - Missing required firstname should return 4xx [expected 400/422]", function () {
